blocking_methods.label: tollFree
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 1800-120-8080 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.

blocking_methods.label: alternate
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 1800-120-8081 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.
Email care@utkarsh.bank from your registered email to request card blocking.
Log in to internet banking at https://www.utkarsh.bank and use the card block/hotlist option.
Block via the bank's mobile app (Cards > Block/Hotlist). Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.utkarsh.bankapp | iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/utkarsh-bank/id1463458813
